description: Store a natural-language memory in CueMap. Uses the repository-scoped default project unless one is supplied, creates it when needed, and applies deterministic cue extraction plus any cues and metadata.

async_ingest.description: Process ingestion in the background and return immediately. Default is false.

content.description: The natural-language memory content to store.

cues.description: Normally omit: CueMap generates cues from content automatically. Optionally add deliberate reusable tags, e.g. type:conversation for an explicitly saved conversation.

disable_temporal_chunking.description: Disable temporal chunking for this memory. Default is false.

event_time.description: Optional original event timestamp as Unix seconds. Defaults to ingestion time.

metadata.description: Optional JSON metadata to store with the memory.

project.description: Optional project ID. Defaults to a stable ID derived from the current Git repository.

source_key.description: Optional stable source key for deterministic upsert/deduplication.

name: cuemap_add
